name: review-triage-negative-context-false-red
title: Allow explicit negative review context without weakening triage-authority rejection
description: A reproducible prompt-envelope classifier false positive blocks every reviewer lane of B-bcae before a reviewRunId can be issued. The triggering text is an explicit negative statement followed by ordinary defect-scope guidance, but the current whole-source relation scan treats the combination as an affirmative authority claim. Narrow the classifier only for structurally explicit negative assertions, keep all positive authority and ambiguous joined-clause cases fail-closed, and add regression coverage for every active modular reviewer role. This supporting lifecycle repair is authorized by the user on 2026-09-06 and must merge locally before B-bcae resumes. No unrelated prompt policy, Story workflow, or Finding semantics are in scope.
